lines.text: Dr Rajendra Prasad was the 1st President (26 January 1950 to 13 May 1962); Droupadi Murmu is the 15th, sworn in on 25 July 2022.
Firsts: Giani Zail Singh was the first Sikh President; Pratibha Devisingh Patil the first woman President; V. V. Giri the first President elected as an independent candidate.
Dr Zakir Husain's term (13 May 1967 to 3 May 1969) ended with his death.
Vice-Presidents who became President: Dr Radhakrishnan (1st Vice-President), V. V. Giri (3rd) and K. R. Narayanan (9th).
lines.problem: Every name/number is supported, but the heading reads as a complete list and the quotes do not establish that only these three VPs became President (in reality Zakir Husain, R. Venkataraman and S. D. Sharma also did). Suggest 'Three Vice-Presidents who became President include ...' or add the others with sources.

lines.text: Radhakrishnan: 1st Vice-President (1952 to 1962) and then 2nd President (1962 to 1967).
Narayanan (10th, 1997 to 2002) comes before Kalam (11th, 2002 to 2007).
Pratibha Patil (2007 to 2012) is followed by Pranab Mukherjee (2012 to 2017), then Ram Nath Kovind (14th, 2017 to 2022).
Giri's presidency began on 24 August 1969; he had been Vice-President from 13 May 1967 to 3 May 1969.
lines.problem: Supported by Giri bio quote; his page's Term of Office field says 3 May 1969 (acting start), so the 24 August 1969 date depends on the bio sentence.
